title: Two symbols interleaved, two strategies: eight signals, ids in publish order
purpose: Each symbol is decided on its own; on one event the strategies act in registration order (the crossover first).

provenance.derived_by: by hand, from the strategy document and the fixture bars; not copied from any run of the tool
derivation: file rows alternate AAPL, MSFT per minute m: AAPL is event_index 2(m-1), MSFT is 2(m-1)+1
AAPL 3 2 1 2 3 4 3 2 1 and MSFT 10 10 10 6 9 2 30 30 30 are worked separately (the other symbol's rows never touch a window)
crossover 2/3: AAPL Buy minute 5 (event 8), Sell minute 8 (event 14); MSFT equal on minute 3, baseline below on minute 4, Buy minute 7 (event 13)

reversion 4, entry 1.2: AAPL Sell minute 5 (z 1.414, event 8), Buy minute 8 (z -1.414, event 14); MSFT Buy minute 4 (z -1.732, event 7), Buy minute 6 (z -1.526, event 11), Sell minute 7 (z 1.686, event 13)
published in file order, and within an event in registration order (crossover, then reversion): ids 1..8 as listed

irrational_double.why: irrational value, rounded to 17 significant digits; the C++ computes it in IEEE double (about 1e-16 relative), so a few ulps of a value below 40 is about 1e-14. 1e-12 leaves two orders of margin and is far below any difference that could change a decision here
